subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Time management helps improve productivity.

P: Procrastination leads to wasted hours.

Q: Creating a schedule prevents delays.

R: It gives direction and reduces stress.

S: Staying disciplined is the key.

6. Success often depends on how we manage time.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence begins with the importance of time management and its effect on productivity.
 
• **Part Q comes first** as it emphasizes creating a schedule to prevent delays:
 
 
• "Creating a schedule prevents delays."
 
 
 
• **Part P follows**, explaining the consequences of procrastination:
 
 
• "Procrastination leads to wasted hours."
 
 
 
• **Part R comes next**, detailing the benefits of time management:
 
 
• "It gives direction and reduces stress."
 
 
 
• **Part S concludes** the sequence, stressing discipline as the key to time management:
 
 
• "Staying disciplined is the key."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QPRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Time management helps improve productivity. Creating a schedule prevents delays. Procrastination leads to wasted hours. It gives direction and reduces stress. Staying disciplined is the key. Success often depends on how we manage time."
